title: Random forest and SVM identify sperm protein biomarkers of bull field fertility
summary: Sperm proteomes (LC-MS) of 54 Irish Holstein bulls (23 low, 14 medium, 17 high fertility) and 18 Danish bulls (8 low, 10 high) were analyzed. A modified t-test selected 301 differentially abundant proteins and random forest selected 34 biomarker proteins. An SVM trained on the Irish bulls predicted fertility class of the Danish bulls with 94.4% accuracy, misclassifying only one high-fertility bull. The validation cohort is small and no functional wet-lab test is reported.
ai_technology: Random forest biomarker selection and SVM classifier

evidence.tested: Training on 54 Irish bulls and validation on 18 independent Danish bulls.
evidence.unknown: Function of the biomarker proteins and performance in larger populations; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Selects 34 biomarker proteins and classifies fertility
